pages.title: Phase Targeting
pages.description: Because spells work  completely in  isolation, you must  use the special form  "Temporal Context"  in order to do  something with the  previous phase's  target.   For example, you can  conjure a voxel in  "begin", and have  Temporal Context in
your "tick" with  Anchor, then  Temporal Context  with Push in your  "end" phase.   This will allow you  to create, aim and  fire a projectile in  the direction you're  aiming.
